name: llamit
description: Generate semantic commit messages using your local Ollama LLM instance. Fast, secure, and fully local.

llamit.ollamaUrl.description: [ESSENTIAL] The URL for the Ollama '/api/generate' endpoint.

llamit.model.description: [ESSENTIAL] The Ollama model to use for generating commit messages.

enumDescriptions: Conventional Commits format with type(scope): description
Angular commit format with strict type/scope rules
Custom format using your own template
llamit.commitFormat.description: [ESSENTIAL] The commit message format to use.

llamit.customFormat.markdownDescription: Custom commit message format template. Only used when `#llamit.commitFormat#` is set to `custom`. Use placeholders like `<type>`, `<scope>`, `<description>` to guide the AI.
llamit.customFormat.description: [ESSENTIAL] Custom format template (only used when commitFormat is 'custom').

llamit.keepAlive.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** How long to keep the model loaded in memory after the request. Examples: `5m` (5 minutes), `60` (60 seconds), `-1` (always keep loaded), `0` (unload immediately).
llamit.keepAlive.description: [ADVANCED] Keep the model loaded in memory (e.g., '5m', '60', '-1').

llamit.temperature.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Temperature for the model (0.0-2.0). Lower values make output more deterministic, higher values more creative. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.topK.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Top-k sampling parameter. Limits the number of highest probability tokens to consider. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default, typically 40).

llamit.topP.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Top-p (nucleus) sampling parameter. Limits the cumulative probability of tokens to consider. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default, typically 0.9).

llamit.numCtx.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Context window size (number of tokens). Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.numPredict.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Maximum number of tokens to predict. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.repeatPenalty.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Repetition penalty. Helps reduce repetitive output. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default, typically 1.1).

llamit.repeatLastN.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** How far back to look for repetition penalty. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default, typically 64).
llamit.repeatLastN.description: [ADVANCED] Look back distance for repetition penalty.

llamit.seed.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Random seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for random. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.numGpu.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Number of GPUs to use. On macOS defaults to 1. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.numThread.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Number of threads to use. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.minP.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Minimum probability sampling. Filters out tokens with probability below this threshold. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.tfsZ.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Tail free sampling parameter. Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.mirostat.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Mirostat sampling algorithm (0: disabled, 1: Mirostat, 2: Mirostat 2.0). Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.mirostatEta.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Mirostat eta parameter (learning rate). Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.mirostatTau.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Mirostat tau parameter (target entropy). Default is 0 (uses Ollama default).

llamit.stop.markdownDescription: **[ADVANCED]** Stop sequences (comma-separated). The model will stop generating when it encounters these sequences.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: VSCE_TARGET="$VSCE_TARGET" node scripts/build-go.js && npm run compile
